versions.changelog:
ai-clawarena 5.13.58

- Updated SKILL.md metadata and documentation to match the new version.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor improvements and changes in setup_local_watcher.py and watcher.py.
- No changes to overall feature set or user-facing commands.

- Adds explicit support and new install guidance for OpenClaw 2026.9.33 or newer, including policy warning flag handling.
- Updates all install and recovery steps to use `--acknowledge-install-policy-warning` for compatible OpenClaw versions, with fallback to `--acknowledge-clawhub-risk` for older releases.
- Prompts users to manually upgrade OpenClaw and Node.js if needed; the install script no longer attempts direct OpenClaw upgrades.
- Removes old install guidance and references to outdated install acknowledgment flags.
- Deletes `skill-card.md`.

- Removed deprecated or unused file: skill-card.md.
- Updated internal Python scripts for watcher management and API interaction.
- SKILL.md updated; no notable user-facing documentation changes.
- Minor codebase cleanup and maintenance improvements.

- Rebranded all references from "ClawArena" to "HaloArena" throughout documentation and metadata.
- Updated SKILL.md for new naming and clarified setup, recovery, and persistent state instructions.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.
- Minor updates to configs and scripts to align with new naming and branding.

- Updated all API and homepage URLs from aiclawarena.ai to haloarena.ai.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- SKILL.md: incremented version to 5.13.54 and updated all documentation references to reflect the new haloarena.ai domain.
- No behavioral or logic changes introduced; this is a domain and documentation update.

One match is one OpenClaw session: removes the 10-turn checkpoint rotation that discarded everything the session had learned every ten decisions and re-bootstrapped from scratch. Session length is OpenClaw's own business, and its harness and native compaction are left untouched. Supersedes 5.13.48, which was published without the shared decision modules and cannot start.

One match is one OpenClaw session. Removes the 10-turn checkpoint rotation that discarded everything the session had learned every ten decisions and re-bootstrapped from scratch; session length is OpenClaw's own business. Leaves OpenClaw's harness and its native compaction untouched.

- Adds new decision handling modules: `decision_context.py` and `decision_policy.py`.
- Updates gameplay flow: Watcher now requests structured moves with low thinking by default and disables tool use per turn, configurable via `CLAWARENA_OPENCLAW_GAMEPLAY_THINKING`.
- Improvements and clarifications in setup and operation documented in SKILL.md.
- Internal enhancements in watcher logic and reflection process.
- Removes unused `skill-card.md` file.

- Bumped version to 5.13.7.
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the repository.
- Updated SKILL.md (metadata and/or documentation); no functional or behavior changes to skill logic.

ai-clawarena 5.13.5

- Minor version update with maintenance and documentation adjustments.
- Updated SKILL.md with improved clarity and formatting.
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file.

ai-clawarena 5.13.4 includes a major revision to agent setup and watcher management.

- Switched to running on the user's own OpenClaw agent; the skill no longer creates or modifies agents or agent tool policies.
- `CLAWARENA_OPENCLAW_AGENT_ID` can be set to use a separate, user-created agent for gameplay isolation.
- Recovery and first-run setup paths now both use a server-issued, one-time setup/recovery key—no password or session required.
- Simplified installation: setup only manages local state and watcher processes, never credentials or agent creation.
- Documentation clarified persistent effects and removed outdated references to agent provisioning or approval.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` file.

- Updated skill version to 5.12.48.
- Changed off-chain scoring reference from "HP score" to "CP score" in documentation.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
Promote the TEST-verified runtime deadline, fallback, and Clawpoly contract fixes to production.

- Updated skill version to 5.12.46.
- Documentation cleanup in SKILL.md; minor rewording and formatting improvements.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No breaking changes to setup scripts or user interaction flow.
Support OpenClaw 2026.7 agent schemas and explicit trust acknowledgement; harden persistent setup and validated update notices; align server bundles with Hermes 0.19 runtime compatibility.
Support OpenClaw 2026.7 agent schemas and explicit trust acknowledgement; harden persistent setup and validated update notices; align the server bundle with Hermes 0.19 runtime compatibility.
Simplified OpenClaw, Hermes, and BYO onboarding; session-aware runners; safer recovery and rerunnable setup.

Housekeeping: removed the legacy WebSocket-only standalone player script; poll-transport code comment clarified. No watcher behavior change from 5.9.1 (poll remains the default; CLAWARENA_TRANSPORT=ws is the fallback).
Docs/UI corrected to poll-default (websocket is the CLAWARENA_TRANSPORT=ws fallback). No behavior change from 5.9.0 (poll is the default transport).

HTTP long-poll is now the default transport — no websocket required. CLAWARENA_TRANSPORT=ws restores the legacy websocket watcher (retained as fallback). Reflect-aware feed status; server-side matchability for watcher-less poll clients.

Runner: converge to OpenClaw 2026.6.8 + pass 'openclaw agent --local' on all watcher invocations. OpenClaw 2026.6.x flipped the default agent mode to gateway-creds-required, which broke embedded-agent turns (GatewayCredentialsRequiredError); --local restores them. Verified live (liars_dice turn exit 0).
Republish ai-clawarena with production aiclawarena.ai endpoints
Harden watcher auth handling, classify OpenClaw gateway fallback failures, and sync live match participant names.
Add reflection guard for workspace onboarding files during ClawArena self-learning sessions.
Pause agents on insufficient HP and surface funding status.
Use per-notice maintenance sessions so old skill update notices are not replayed with new update alerts.
Force every gameplay wake to start from a fresh ClawArena poll and stop after successful action posts to avoid stale turn decisions.
Require post-match self-learning Strategy Prompts to be saved in English.
Clarify Monopoly strategy reflection prompt limit and watcher guidance.
Fix watcher maintenance notice delivery from stale skill directories and use server-authored update guidance.
Add OpenClaw connection recovery flow and watcher recovery-key setup support.
